plan.title: Explore data structure and existing workspace artifacts
plan.description: Examine the data directory structure: count images, inspect annotations.json (number of annotations, categories, image sizes), check what's already in yolo_mc/, yolo_sc/, splits/ directories. Look at metadata.json. Understand what previous work has been done.
plan.success_criteria: Complete inventory of data, existing splits, existing YOLO format data, and understanding of annotation statistics

plan.title: Inspect annotation details, categories, and product reference images
plan.description: Deep dive into: (1) annotation fields (bbox format, corrected flag, area stats), (2) category-to-product mapping via metadata.json, (3) products/ directory structure - how many products have reference images, image types, (4) store section distribution from filenames, (5) bbox size distribution relative to image size. This combines original steps 2-4.
plan.success_criteria: Complete understanding of data format, category mapping, reference image availability, and annotation quality.

plan.title: Create train/val split, YOLO labels, evaluation function, and data.yaml
plan.description: All-in-one data prep: (1) 90/10 stratified split by store section, seed=42, (2) COCO-format split JSONs, (3) YOLO-format labels for both multi-class (356 cats) and single-class, (4) data.yaml for ultralytics, (5) evaluation function computing val_score = 0.7*det_mAP@0.5 + 0.3*cls_mAP@0.5 using pycocotools. Test eval with dummy predictions.
plan.success_criteria: Split files created, YOLO labels verified, evaluation function returns correct scores on dummy data.

plan.title: Baseline: YOLOv8m multi-class at 640
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8m with 356 classes at 640px provides a reasonable baseline. Skip n/s since we have few images and need capacity for 356 classes.
plan.description: Train YOLOv8m on train split with nc=356, imgsz=640, 100 epochs, default augmentation. Evaluate on val split using our evaluation function. Record val_score, detection_mAP, classification_mAP.

plan.title: YOLOv8x multi-class at 1280
plan.hypothesis: Larger model + higher resolution will significantly improve both detection and classification on dense shelf images with small products.
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x nc=356, imgsz=1280, 150 epochs, batch size adjusted for GPU memory. Compare val_score to step 4 baseline.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improves by at least 5 points over step 4

plan.title: YOLOv8x single-class detector at 1280
plan.hypothesis: Single-class detector will have higher detection recall since it only needs to localize, not classify. This becomes the detection backbone for two-stage approach.
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x nc=1, imgsz=1280, 150 epochs. Record detection_mAP@0.5. Compare detection recall to multi-class model.

plan.title: Build DINOv2 embedding + kNN classification pipeline
plan.description: Implement: (1) crop extraction from training images using GT boxes at original resolution, (2) DINOv2-base (or large if fits) embedding extraction for all crops, (3) gallery from training crops + reference product images, (4) kNN classifier with cosine similarity. Save gallery embeddings.
plan.success_criteria: Pipeline runs end-to-end, can classify a crop and return category_id with confidence.

plan.title: Two-stage: best detector + DINOv2 kNN classification
plan.hypothesis: DINOv2 embeddings will provide better classification than YOLO for rare categories, improving classification_mAP and overall val_score.
plan.description: Run best single-class detector on val images, extract crops from original-resolution images, classify with DINOv2 kNN. Compute val_score. Compare to best multi-class YOLO val_score. Also try confidence-gated hybrid: use YOLO class when confident, DINOv2 otherwise.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improves over best pure YOLO approach

plan.title: NMS tuning and SAHI tiled inference
plan.hypothesis: Dense shelf images benefit from adjusted NMS thresholds and tiled inference to catch small products.
plan.description: Sweep NMS IoU {0.4,0.5,0.6,0.7} and conf threshold {0.05,0.1,0.15,0.2,0.25}. Also implement SAHI-style tiled inference (1280x1280 tiles with overlap + full image, merge with WBF). Compare val_score for each configuration.
plan.success_criteria: Find optimal NMS/conf settings, tiled inference improves detection_mAP by 2+ points

plan.title: Extended training and augmentation tuning
plan.hypothesis: With 356 categories and limited data, longer training with optimized augmentation (close_mosaic, copy-paste, label smoothing) will improve convergence.
plan.description: Train best model config for 300 epochs with close_mosaic=50, label_smoothing=0.1. Also try copy-paste augmentation. Compare val_score to shorter training.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improves by 1+ points over shorter training

plan.title: kNN tuning and gallery optimization
plan.hypothesis: Optimal k, distance weighting, gallery composition, and crop padding affect classification quality.
plan.description: Sweep: k={1,3,5,7,11}, distance weighting, gallery variants (crops only, refs only, both), crop padding (0%, 10%, 20%). Use best detector's val predictions.
plan.success_criteria: Find optimal kNN config, classification_mAP improves by 1+ points

plan.title: RT-DETR training and model ensemble
plan.hypothesis: RT-DETR has different error profile from YOLO; ensembling with WBF improves detection.
plan.description: Train RT-DETR-l nc=356 (or nc=1), imgsz=1280, 150 epochs. Ensemble YOLO + RT-DETR predictions with WBF. Sweep ensemble weights.
plan.success_criteria: Ensemble val_score > best single model by 1+ points

plan.title: TTA and final inference optimization
plan.hypothesis: Test-time augmentation adds 1-2 mAP with no retraining.
plan.description: Run best pipeline with TTA (multi-scale + flip). Also try multi-crop DINOv2 (average embeddings from original + padded + center-zoomed crops). Measure val_score and inference time.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improves, inference time stays reasonable (<300s for full test set)

plan.title: Build final submission pipeline
plan.description: Write run.py with best configuration: detector + classifier + post-processing. Ensure correct output format (COCO predictions.json), no blocked imports, total weight size < 420MB. Export to ONNX if beneficial. End-to-end test on val split.
plan.success_criteria: Pipeline runs end-to-end, produces correct output format, fits size constraints, runs within time limit.

plan.title: Final validation and submission test
plan.hypothesis: Final submission produces correct predictions within all constraints.
plan.description: Run complete pipeline on val images simulating test conditions. Verify output format, timing, file sizes. Confirm val_score matches expectations. Make any final adjustments.
plan.success_criteria: val_score matches best experimental result, all constraints satisfied.
